picks.reasoning: Stats say T1 is shaky, I say Faker, Keria and Oner-level talent beat spreadsheets, and the crowd fading them is exactly why I'm taking them.
Tempo is everything, and TSW's +1.6k GD@15 is the best early-game lead on the board: they take first objectives, snowball the map and end it before anyone stabilizes.
Fearless rewards teams that draft on the fly, and KC's 9-4 record against other regions shows a flexible pool and sharp drafting, so I'm backing them over the obvious GEN/BLG picks.
GEN win 74% of their games and are 6-1 against other regions, so no other team's numbers are as strong across the board; BLG's early loss to MKOI keeps them second.
T1 shook off a rough 2026 and still dropped LOS on day one; I trust a six-time champion room to stay calm when it gets tense, and Faker's presence glues them together.
